This message does not authorise the automatic launch of all readings and does not authorise a new BATCH_COMMIT. Registered in the persistent queue so the line survives this session; no concurrent write on any surface another task holds.
CURRENT_STATE: INTAKE COMPLETE — wave 1 PROPOSED and NOT launched. 32 of 32 PMIDs identified and classified; availability verified by content rather than by status code; first wave of 3 papers proposed with Scientist assignment. No reading opened, no receipt written, no canonical file touched, no push.
OBJECTIVE: Build a verifiable scientific base over the 32 PMIDs of the Aldaz line, for a later analysis of evidence, divergences and gaps, analogous to the Aqeilan batch: per-PMID bibliographic identity and relation to the line, presence in registries, receipts and artefacts already held, real availability of full text, figures and supplements, integrity notices, and a motivated first wave that reuses verified work instead of repeating it.

SCOPE.line_membership: C. Marcelo Aldaz is a co-author on 32 of 32, verified in the PubMed author list of each record, never inferred from the title. Senior/last author on 14; middle author, i.e. collaborator on another group's work, on 18 — which is why the line is not one laboratory's evidence and its members are not mutually independent confirmations.

availability.operator_statement: The operator indicated all papers as free full text. Verified rather than assumed, and the result is more differentiated.
availability.method_correction: A first probe classified availability by HTTP status. That was wrong twice over and both errors are recorded rather than hidden: the PMC oa.fcgi endpoint answered 404 for every identifier, i.e. it is a dead route and not a licence finding; and one response of HTTP 200 held 5,439 bytes belonging to PMC11113964 / PMID 25238781, a different article, because the probe wrote into a shared /tmp path. The classification below re-derives availability from CONTENT — a body element, a section count, and the PMID asserted inside the document — with one file per paper in the session scratchpad.

structured_fulltext_verified.route: Europe PMC fullTextXML; 76 KB to 177 KB, 13 to 38 sections, PMID matching inside the document in every case.

no_structured_surface_by_that_route.note: Mostly NIH author manuscripts outside the PMC open-access subset. NCBI efetch db=pmc returns a 197-byte stub carrying the comment that the publisher does not allow XML download — measured today on three of them. This is NOT unavailability of the paper: 30290271 and 24871327 were both read to complete_fulltext_read from the PMC web surface, which is the proof that this class is readable by another route and at a higher acquisition cost.

aldaz_nappi_abstract.recorded_as: Not identified. The search stops here as instructed; it is not reopened without a new lead from the operator. What the operator reported is registered as an unverified operator report, never as a scientific premise and never as an expectation about the result. The nearest verifiable repurposing work of this group is a clarithromycin lung-cancer-prevention study with Aldaz as last author, which concerns neither WWOX nor the nervous system and is not part of this batch.
aldaz_nappi_abstract.pre_existing_related_note: The discovery ledger already carries, under DL-MECH-012, an operator-memory note about an Aldaz repurposing grant whose drug name was recorded as NOT verified in the literature as of 2026-07-03. Today's search does not close it either; it stays unverified.

proposed_wave_1.status: PROPOSED — not launched. Launching is the operator's, per the perimeter of this mandate.
proposed_wave_1.ordering_principle: Not by date, not by author seniority, not by proximity to a possible therapy. Each paper is here because it answers a stated question, carries a real dependency, adds evidence the corpus does not already hold, or discriminates between hypotheses.

papers.work: TARGETED RESUMPTION to complete_fulltext_read, not a re-read
papers.question: Does the P47T partial loss-of-function model support, qualify or narrow what CLAIM 006 and CLAIM 007 assert at consolidated-baseline strength?
papers.why_now: It is the only paper in this batch with an epileptic phenotype, the reference-genotype-relevant one, and the only one where abundance/function dissociation is attested in vivo for WWOX itself. Two consolidated baseline claims already rest on it while no reading of it was ever finished.
papers.new_evidence_versus_what_is_held: The two not_read sections close from a surface verified today: the Europe PMC XML is 169,357 bytes with 32 sections and a 62-entry reference list, all 62 carrying a PMID. So references stops being a declared debt, and the reference-list screen becomes runnable.
papers.dependencies: None outstanding. paper_packet procedures reports acquisition OPEN because no artefact of this paper is present in this checkout; the locator-contradiction procedure is to-ascertain against 26 persisted locator entries and must be settled BEFORE any manifest edit.
papers.cost_measured_not_estimated: One XML fetch of 169 KB. Nine figures to re-acquire as pixels, of which four were inspected in 2026-08 and five never were. The XML declares 0 table-wrap elements, which means the in-body tables recorded as not_read are not in this surface and their absence must be declared rather than closed. Four supplementary-material blocks are declared in the XML; the supplement remains unreachable today — Europe PMC supplementaryFiles answered 404 again and oa.fcgi is a dead endpoint — so the supplement stays a declared debt unless a genuinely new route appears. No token estimate is given: this deployment cannot measure it.
papers.gap_that_will_remain: Supplementary, hence the four locators that cite a supplementary value as the source of a number nobody saw. The reading may not be declared complete while they stand; coverage stays honest at unavailable.

papers.question: Is the neuroinflammation of WWOX partial loss of function an intrinsic progressive process, or a sensitised response to an extrinsic trigger? The two papers answer this only as a pair.
papers.why_now: It is the only primary source in the batch that tests the axis under a systemic challenge, and one of the three legs on which DL-MECH-012 is tagged DATO as convergent over three models — a tag that today rests on one partial reading, one unread preprint and one unread lung paper.
papers.read_as_a_set_with_36828035: Same laboratory and an overlapping model class, which is exactly why one reader takes both and why neither may be counted as independent confirmation of the other. The pairing is the INTERNAL_EDGES fact to resolve at M0, from the artefacts, not from this record: whether it is literally the same P47T line is to be ascertained by the reader.
papers.cost_measured_not_estimated: Europe PMC serves no XML. The PMC web surface answered HTTP 200 with 93,523 bytes to a request carrying no User-Agent, and the bioRxiv API resolves the DOI with a JATS source XML address, so two independent routes exist.
papers.epistemic_caveat_for_the_dispatch: It is a preprint, not peer-reviewed, licence cc_no. No published version was identified in Europe PMC. Anything it yields carries that status; 41090157, 38563965 and 33058734 each have a Preprint in link, so preprint-versus-published must be resolved per paper and not by batch habit.

papers.question: In which cell compartments is WWOX protein actually present in normal human tissue — and does that support or refuse a cell-autonomous glial reading of any neuroinflammation finding?
papers.why_now: It is the discriminator the compartment argument needs, and it is already a named ALTA debt in the queue as FT-079, opened by scientist-b's own 2026-09-09 reading of 18674750, whose Figure S3 showed a WWOX product in all nine human tissues including brain while the article text named only four. It is also the protein-level counterpart of that endpoint RT-PCR gel, which is weak evidence of relative abundance.
papers.cost_measured_not_estimated: No structured surface by the Europe PMC route; efetch returns the 197-byte publisher stub. It is the pdf_only class the queue already classified in FT-057, so acquisition is the PMC web surface. Short paper, no supplement declared.
papers.why_not_38563965_instead: 38563965 is the recorded first substitute. It is the third leg of DL-MECH-012 and a cell-type-specific causal test, but it is a lung endothelial model with a longer transfer path, and it does not discriminate the compartment question inside the nervous system. If 39868255 parks on acquisition, 38563965 takes its place rather than a fourth reader being opened.

scientist_assignment_rationale.principle: Two actors, not three, and each for a reason in its own contract. Involving all three by default would be parallelism as a habit, and roles/scientist.md makes the reading mode a property of the task, never a standing specialisation.
scientist_assignment_rationale.scientist-a: Contract AQEILAN-FT-A-001, theme neuro / WOREE-adjacent biology, which is where both wave papers sit. Decisive, and verifiable in the history: commit 75c7f0b of 2026-09-07 is Scientist A's own reading of 36828035 to depth. A resumption by the reader who declared the gaps is not a duplicated reading; it is the resume the receipt contract provides for, with reread_reason inadequate_prior_coverage and prior_receipt set. Its lot is otherwise closed.
scientist_assignment_rationale.scientist-b: Contract AQEILAN-FT-B-001, CLOSED with all eight PMIDs worked, so the actor is free. It takes 16941225 because it is the reader whose multi-hop created FT-079: the debt and its provenance stay with the actor that can say what the gel did and did not show.
scientist_assignment_rationale.scientist-c: NOT involved, deliberately. Its theme is bone/osteosarcoma, NF-kB and mutational signatures, which no wave-1 paper touches; its lot is complete with two contract findings still REFERRED to the operator; and it already holds the one reading of this batch that must not be repeated, 41562193. Adding it would duplicate context without adding evidence.
scientist_assignment_rationale.no_duplicate_assignment: Each wave PMID has exactly one owner, so no PARALLEL_READ_GROUP is declared and none is needed. Two contracts on one source would be legal only with a shared group, and there is none here.

blinding.rule: The first scientific pass stays blind, per scientist_reading_modes.md § 3.1: the reader receives the source packet and nothing else about the paper.
blinding.what_is_excluded_from_the_reader_brief: This laboratory's prior conclusions, the claims that rest on these papers, the DL-MECH-012 tag, the repurposing question, and the operator's report about an Aldaz-Nappi abstract. The four abstracts read during this intake were used only to motivate the wave and do not enter any brief.
blinding.where_the_comparison_happens: In the phase the protocol provides for, after the reading and against the artefacts — never inside the first pass.

synthesis_discipline_for_the_later_phase.required_separation: Observed results · authors' interpretations · this laboratory's inferences · divergences between experimental contexts · still-open questions, kept apart rather than merged.
synthesis_discipline_for_the_later_phase.non_independence_rule: Same-group studies, reused data and overlapping cohorts do not become independent confirmations. Concretely for this batch: 14 of 32 are senior-authored by the same laboratory; 36828035 and 39868255 share a laboratory and probably a model; DL-MECH-012 is currently tagged as convergent over three models that are three outputs of one group.

telemetry_plan.principle: No new measurement system, no new database, no second registry. Each of the five categories the operator named already has a durable surface, and the wave writes into the surface that exists.
telemetry_plan.scientific_reading: verbatim_locators entries in disease-models/wwox/research/deepdive_manifests/PMID<PMID>.json plus the coverage map of the receipt in fulltext_read_receipts.jsonl.
telemetry_plan.acquisition_and_rendering: retrieval_manifest.jsonl, whose records already carry actor, kind, artifact_path, declared_sha256, recipe, no_recipe_reason, task and recorded_at; page-adjudication crops under research/page_adjudications/; the two-instrument raster measurements of paper_packet.py surfaces.
telemetry_plan.comparison: comparison_check.py facts and inventory, and phase_handoff.py prepare --phase comparison.
telemetry_plan.verification: deepdive_manifest.py strict validation, evidence_presence.py for artefact presence and digest match, locator_audit.py and locator_contradiction_audit.py for the blind audit and its queue.
telemetry_plan.repair: reacquire.py replay and record for a route replayed and diffed, recapture_snippets.py where normalisation and not the reader moved the text.
telemetry_plan.per_wave_bookkeeping: DEFAULTS_TAKEN and STOP_LOG inside each WAVE_n_RESULT of the scientist contract, required even when empty (Annex A.1b), and event_ledger.py append for P7 events.
telemetry_plan.experimental_tools_not_promoted: Nothing experimental is adopted by this proposal. No PaperQA2 and no API-keyed or paid retrieval: that is external spend, reserved. Where a route is merely untried rather than adopted, it is named as a route to test and not as a capability.

dominant_difficulty_observed.status: PROVISIONAL — observed during this intake. The one dominant difficulty of the wave itself is due at wave close, from the wave's own artefacts.
dominant_difficulty_observed.statement: A registry declaration that the full text was reviewed is treated as an attestation of reading by the consumers that matter, so a paper nobody opened can present as read.
evidence_from_the_code_not_from_impressi: coverage_report.py line 142 returns max(registry_depth, receipt_depth), and its FULL_TEXT_MARKERS include the bare strings full text reviewed and full text verificato — so a registry sentence alone raises a paper to full_text depth and no disagreement is reported.

session_self_eval.py line 103 clears an unread premise when the PAPER block contains full text reviewed — the declaration silences the very ratchet built to catch a conclusion leaning on an unopened paper.

The intake script of legend-study-intake-triage reads the paper registry, the tracking log and the queue, and no receipt surface, so it returned KNOWN_INTEGRATED for 24369382 and 24932569, whose only receipts are legacy reconstructions with nine unknown_legacy keys.
dominant_difficulty_observed.measured_instances_in_this_batch: 3 of 32: 24369382, 24932569, 30619736. The third is the sharpest — sole primary source of CLAIM 026, declared full text verificato, no receipt anywhere, and absent from reading_state.md, where absence of a row is indistinguishable from absence of debt.

pattern_consulted.primary: Review 11 Scholar Loop § D, validate the artifact and not the producer's report — Stato VERY STRONG. The registry row is the producer's report; the receipt and the manifest are the artefact.
converging: Review 15 OpenScientist § 8, document access is not deep-reading proof — VERY STRONG distinction
Review 06 Paperclip § K, a declared deep-reading instruction is not a deterministic reading receipt — STRONGER
Review 12 ResearchOS § U, runtime success can conceal scientific incompleteness — VERY STRONG

already_implemented_and_why_it_did_not_h.implemented: The per-item explicit state of Gemma § B and the source accounting of Gemma § I exist as reading_state.py, and the page is not stale: reading_state.py --check reports CURRENT against the committed copy, and it does show the truth, including the nine unknown_legacy keys of 24369382 and 24932569.
why_it_did_not_help: Nothing reconciles that page against the registry declaration, so the two surfaces disagree in silence and the declaration is the one the consumers read.
A paper with zero receipts has no row at all, so 30619736 is invisible there rather than flagged — absence of evidence presents as absence of debt.
No intake path consults it: the triage script's own source list does not include it.

dominant_difficulty_observed.minimal_change_proposed: One existing consumer prints the disagreement instead of absorbing it: coverage_report.py emits a DECLARED_NOT_ATTESTED row whenever a registry FULL_TEXT_MARKER has no corresponding complete_fulltext_read receipt, counting a paper with no receipt as a case rather than skipping it. One function in a file that already parses both inputs. No new file, no new registry, no new measurement system, and the ratchet in session_self_eval is left untouched in this proposal.
dominant_difficulty_observed.success_criterion_fixed_in_advance: The three known cases appear — 24369382, 24932569, 30619736 — and no paper holding a complete receipt appears. A fourth case appearing is a finding to read, not a failure of the check.
dominant_difficulty_observed.not_an_infrastructure_project: This is a proposal with a provenance, a minimal change and a criterion. Research continues; nothing here opens a new infrastructural programme, and the change is not implemented by this task.

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: The derived inventory lands in disease-models/wwox/research/ and not in analysis/orchestration_reviews/, where the Aqeilan dispatches sit.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: analysis/orchestration_reviews/, the precedent surface; or spelling the identifiers in a form the scanner does not match.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: session_self_eval.PREMISE_GLOBS covers analysis/**/*.md, therapeutics/*.md and meta/*.md; a citation clears only with a complete receipt, a queue entry, or a PAPER block declaring full text reviewed. Most of these 32 are CORPUS-STUB records with status not_processed, unread_premise_baseline is 2 and the current count is exactly 2, so an inventory of 26 unread identifiers placed in analysis/ would raise the count and fail the gate. Deforming the spelling to dodge a scanner would make the record less readable and the check less true.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.reversibility: Immediate: the file is a derived document and can be moved once such a record is representable where the precedent puts it.

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: No subagent was opened and no agent per PMID.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: One delegate per paper, or a fan-out over the 32.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: The operator asked for no unnecessary delegation on a deterministic intake, and delegate reports survive only in subagent transcripts, which is where a finding goes to die.

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: Availability was re-derived from document content after the first probe proved unreliable, and both errors are recorded in this file.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: Keeping the status-code table, which was already written.
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: A 200 is not a full text. One 200 carried another article entirely, and oa.fcgi answered 404 for all 32 because the endpoint is dead — reported as a licence finding it would have been a fabrication.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Committing the tree wholesale would have landed another task's work under this task's message.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The instruction was explicit that the search be bounded and that an unverifiable source be recorded as not identified. It is registered as an operator report, never as a premise.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: An unbounded search, or an unverified abstract entering the reasoning as if it were evidence.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: 36828035 declares four supplementary-material blocks that no available route reaches today.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: The supplement stays a declared debt with the cascade recorded; the resumption is planned as honestly partial on that surface rather than as a completion.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Exhausting a tranche is not having read the surface. The coverage value stays unavailable and the dependent conclusions stay narrowed.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: A completion claim resting on four locators that cite values nobody has seen.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Prior figures of four of the five complete reads are absent from this checkout, so a fresh figure inspection is not possible without re-acquisition.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Their locators and dossiers are treated as reusable; no figure claim is refreshed and none is re-asserted from memory.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: evidence_presence reports the absence explicitly, and a locator already verified against a fingerprinted artefact does not need the bytes present to be cited as prior work.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Either a pointless re-acquisition of four papers, or a figure statement with no surface behind it.
